Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a significant mediastinal shift to the right (away from the affected side). This radiographic pattern indicates a space-occupying lesion, such as a massive pleural effusion or pyothorax, which pushes the mediastinum to the contralateral side, whereas lung collapse or atelectasis would pull it towards the affected side.
